command:

echo "STEP: disable all remote AlmaLinux repos (keep local-file enabled)"
sudo -n mkdir -p /root/repo-backup

  sudo -n cp "$f" /root/repo-backup/
  sudo -n sed -i 's/^enabled=1/enabled=0/' "$f"
done
grep -H '^enabled' /etc/yum.repos.d/almalinux-*.repo

echo "STEP: block outbound http/https to simulate remote repos unreachable"
sudo -n iptables -C OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -j REJECT 2>/dev/null || sudo -n iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -j REJECT
sudo -n iptables -C OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j REJECT 2>/dev/null || sudo -n iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j REJECT
sudo -n iptables -L OUTPUT -n | grep -E '80|443'

sudo -n dnf --disablerepo="local-file" repolist 2>&1 | tail -20 || true

tail -30 /tmp/phaseB-install.log
